candidate_object: Every pair consisting of L=PSL(2,2^f), f>=2, and its complete involution class D, together with the identical A5 pair represented by PSL(2,5)=PSL(2,4).

target_vs_witness.canonical_target: Every finite nonabelian simple L and every complete involution class D in L.
target_vs_witness.bounded_claim: Every simple even-characteristic PSL(2,q), q=2^f with f>=2, plus q=5 only through the identical abstract A5 pair already covered at q=4.

q5_identification.statement: PSL(2,5) is isomorphic to PSL(2,4) isomorphic to A5, and A5 has one involution class; no general odd-characteristic inference is made.

odd_family_status.statement: The trace/norm model is derived, but the odd orthogonal-shell rigidity lemma remains unproved.

q27_audit_status.statement: The single leased q=27 automorphism-order audit is a finite stress test only and is not used to prove the bounded even-characteristic theorem.

rows.candidate_value: The submitted theorem explicitly quantifies over every pair in the stated PSL(2,2^f) subfamily and the identical q=5/A5 pair; it does not claim the canonical all-simple-groups quantifier.
For f>=2, PSL(2,2^f) is finite nonabelian simple; the q=5 transfer is the identical simple group A5 represented at q=4.
The vector-nilpotent model enumerates all q^2-1 involutions and proves SL(2,q)-transitivity; A5 has the same unique involution class at q=4 and q=5.
The graph is complete on the exact class, and every distinct pair receives the exact order determined by the characteristic polynomial T^2+det(x,y)^2 T+1.
The proof uses the literal setwise stabilizers of exact t-edge sets; finite bijectivity converts the source implication to equality, and absent positive labels impose no condition, hence Aut_t=S_D.
The exact order q(q-1)(q+1) in even characteristic is divisible by 2 and 3, so the second-smallest distinct prime divisor is p=3; the A5 order is 60.
Aut(Gamma) is treated as the intersection over every occurring exact product-order colour, with absent-label factors vacuous.

For every q=2^f, f>=2, the functional equation gives Aut_2 intersect Aut_3=GammaSL(2,q), and the trace formula proves that this group preserves every colour; q=5 is covered only as the identical A5 pair.
